messages:
DataCorp Support: Hey team — we're seeing intermittent 504s hitting /v1/generate for tenant T-0421 between 2026-03-15T14:10Z and 2026-03-15T14:18Z. Billing shows a token spike in that window and some audit entries for those requests are missing. Sample request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Can someone triage?
Priya: Thanks — escalating. Can you confirm the affected user ids and any SSO/SCIM changes around that time? Tagging @Nina for audit/KMS checks. :eyes: 
DataCorp Support: Affected users: alice@datacorp.com, bob@datacorp.com. No config changes on our side. They reported auth retries and a long latency before the 504s.
Alex: Noted. First guess: KMS unwrap timeouts causing auth token delays -> retries -> client-side timeouts. Priya, I'm going to pull the infra logs for those request ids.
SRE-Bot: alert: tenant=T-0421 high rate of 5xx responses (2026-03-15T14:12Z - 2026-03-15T14:16Z) incident=#INC-4729
Marco: Can you paste one full request_id and an exact sample timestamp? I'll run a targeted log query. Also, do you have the X-Request-Id header value from the client?
DataCorp Support: Sample: req_0a1b2c3d, timestamp 2026-03-15T14:12:07Z. X-Request-Id header: x-req-42a7
Marco: Running quick query:
```
redwood-log query "tenant:T-0421 AND request:req_0a1b2c3d" --from "2026-03-15T14:00Z" --to "2026-03-15T14:30Z" --json
```
Marco: I see repeated KMS unwrap timeouts around 14:12:05-14:12:20Z. Partial log snippet: `hsm_unwrap_timeout=true error_code=HSM-13 retry=3 latency_ms=12000`
Nina: If HSM unwraps failed, that explains missing audit entries — the control plane may have deferred writes while retrying. We need to capture HSM audit trail and KMS gateway logs for preservation. Legal hold requested by @Tanya.
Tanya: Put legal hold on all logs for tenant T-0421 for 2026-03-15 14:00-15:00Z. Do not purge. We may need retained evidence for a compliance review.
Priya: DataCorp, we will preserve logs and run an audit export. ETA for initial artifacts: ~4 hours. Marco, can you dump HSM unwrap logs + control-plane audit writes and share secure link?
Marco: Will do. Commands I used:
```
# infra internal
hsmctl fetch --tenant T-0421 --from 2026-03-15T14:00Z --to 2026-03-15T14:30Z > /tmp/T-0421-hsm.ndjson
redwood-audit export --tenant T-0421 --range "2026-03-15T14:00:00Z/2026-03-15T15:00:00Z" --format ndjson --out /tmp/T-0421-audit.ndjson
```
Marco: uploaded artifacts to secure bucket (internal link) and added to the incident.
Priya: Thanks. Two parallel actions: 1) Security to verify whether any audit lines are permanently missing or just delayed. 2) Support + Billing to review the token/billing spike and consider a customer credit.
Nina: Early read — control-plane shows delayed audit flushes tied to HSM retries; no evidence of data exfiltration. I'll run a deeper integrity check on audit sequence numbers.
DataCorp Support: Appreciate it. We need an interim status for our compliance team — can you confirm if the missing audit lines are recoverable?
Marco: Likely recoverable from the audit export — we have appended writes that were delayed. If any entries are not present, they correlate with HSM unwrap failures and will show as failed-write records.
Priya: Billing: @Tanya, please advise on retention policy for exported artifacts. Also opening billing claim for the token spike — creating ticket BILL-989.
Tanya: Retain exports for 90 days under legal hold. No deletions.
Alex: Short-term mitigation: temporarily set `kms_fallback=false` for tenant T-0421 to avoid cascading retries while we stabilize HSM. Will coordinate rollback once HSM latency resolves.
DataCorp Support: Please do not change tenant config without our permission — can you apply a proxy throttle instead? We prefer no config drift.
Priya: Understood. We'll apply a rate-limit proxy rule for that tenant for the next 2 hours and share the change log.
Marco: Confirmed HSM provider reported a brief maintenance window at 14:10Z that correlates. They're pushing a patch for a retry backoff bug. I set a temporary rate-limit: 60 req/min for T-0421.
SRE-Bot: deployment: rate-limit rule applied to tenant T-0421 by Marco at 2026-03-15T15:08Z :white_check_mark:
DataCorp Support: Thanks — can you also advise next steps for a billing credit and the audit evidence we can share with our compliance team?
Priya: Billing claim created (BILL-989). We will include a summary and the exported audit ndjson. Expect a follow-up from billing within 24 hours. Security will produce a short incident summary for compliance.
Nina: I'll produce an integrity report (sequence gaps, HSM error correlation) and attach to the incident. ETA 6 hours.
DataCorp Support: Good. Appreciate the help. Please keep this thread updated.
Priya: Will do — keeping thread open until incident closed and evidence delivered. :v:
notes: escalation: SSO/KMS/HSM + billing + audit retention; legal hold requested
